actions.reason: BasicTokenizer.train now keeps the token ids as a str of code points chr(id). Pair search (str.find) and merging (str.replace) run in C and match the old left-to-right, non-overlapping merge() exactly. Pair counts are updated with the same logic as _update_stats, only at the found occurrences, and ties are broken by earliest first occurrence via find. This drops the repeated full-list count/index scans the old code did on every merge. The old list path is kept as a fallback for vocab_size > 0x110000. Outputs are identical; train_ir ratio 0.717.
